//go:build fts5

package db

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "testing"

    "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestGenerateUsageCacheV21(t *testing.T) {
    dir := os.Getenv("USAGE_V21_FIXTURE_DIR")
    require.NotEmpty(t, dir)
    path := filepath.Join(dir, "archive.db")
    database, err := Open(t.Context(), path)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "one")
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "two")
    seedUsageSnapshotSession(t, database, "earlier", "project-a", "2026-08-10T09:00:00Z", 0, 10, "model-a")
    seedUsageSnapshotSession(t, database, "later", "project-b", "2026-08-10T10:00:00Z", 0, 20, "model-a")
    for _, row := range []struct { id, project, timestamp string; output int }{
        {"no-request-a", "project-a", "2026-08-10T09:00:00Z", 10},
        {"no-request-b", "project-b", "2026-08-10T10:00:00Z", 20},
    } {
        insertSession(t, database, row.id, row.project, func(session *Session) { session.Agent = "claude"; session.StartedAt = &row.timestamp })
        require.NoError(t, database.InsertMessages(t.Context(), []Message{{SessionID: row.id, Ordinal: 0, Role: "assistant", Timestamp: row.timestamp, Model: "model-a", ClaudeMessageID: "no-request-shared", TokenUsage: []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"output_tokens":%d}`, row.output))}}))
    }
    seedJournaledUsage(t, database, "event-owner")
    require.NoError(t, database.InsertCursorUsageEvents(t.Context(), []CursorUsageEvent{{OccurredAt: "2026-08-10T11:00:00Z", Model: "cursor-model", InputTokens: 30, DedupKey: "cursor"}}))
    cache := warmJournaledUsage(t, database, UsageFilter{Timezone: "UTC", Breakdowns: true, PairwiseSides: true})
    cachePath := cache.path
    require.NoError(t, database.Close())
    require.NoError(t, os.Rename(cachePath, filepath.Join(dir, "cache.db")))
}
